ref_text: HE SET OFF ABRUPTLY FOR THE BULL WALKING RAPIDLY LEST HIS FATHER'S SHRILL WHISTLE MIGHT CALL HIM BACK AND IN A FEW MOMENTS HE HAD ROUNDED THE CURVE AT THE POLICE BARRACK AND WAS SAFE
text: He set off abruptly for the bull, walking rapidly, less his father's shrill whistle might call him back. And in a few moments he had rounded the curve at the police barrack and was safe.
